text:
The current in a lamp at full brightness is 0.25A. The flexible cable to the lamp is designed for
currents up to 5.0A, so it can safely carry the 0.25A taken by the lamp.
Which fuse should be inserted in the plug at the other end of the flexible cable?
A
0.2A
B
1.0A
C
5.0A
D
10.0A
subject: Physics
